description: SCAR-L Prism: rainbow liquid chrome for the MK16 SCAR-L, smears of cyan, green, gold, orange, pink and blue over violet. The whole paint rolls over the gun like a lava lamp (VAR-12; an older client shows the plain SCAR-L). An animated weapon variant: it looks different and plays exactly the same.
name: SCAR-L Prism
